concept.description: Verifies that each Maven project references two source directories.
concept.cypher: WITH [ "module1/src/main/java", "module1/target/generated-sources/annotations", "module2/src/main/java", "module2/target/generated-sources/annotations" ] as expectedPaths UNWIND expectedPaths as expectedPath MATCH (:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_SOURCE_DIRECTORY]->(:File:Directory{path:expectedPath}) RETURN count(*) as count

concept.description: Verifies that each Maven project references a test source directory.
concept.cypher: WITH [ "module1/src/test/java", "module1/target/generated-test-sources/test-annotations", "module2/src/test/java", "module2/target/generated-test-sources/test-annotations" ] as expectedPaths UNWIND expectedPaths as expectedPath MATCH (:Maven:Project)-[:HAS_TEST_SOURCE_DIRECTORY]->(:File:Directory{path:expectedPath}) RETURN count(*) as count

concept.description: Verifies that each Java type references a source file.
concept.cypher: WITH [ "module1/src/main/java/com/buschmais/jqassistant/maven/module1/A.java", "module1/src/test/java/com/buschmais/jqassistant/maven/module1/ATest.java", "module2/src/main/java/com/buschmais/jqassistant/maven/module2/B.java", "module2/src/test/java/com/buschmais/jqassistant/maven/module2/BTest.java" ] as expectedPaths UNWIND expectedPaths as expectedPath MATCH (:Type)-[:HAS_SOURCE_FILE]->(:File{path:expectedPath}) RETURN count(*) as count
